metadata.title: COBO L2 Endpoint SSPP
metadata.remarks: System Security and Privacy Plan defining the enhanced-assurance institutional managed endpoint trust tier (COBO L2).

import-profile.remarks: Institutional security and privacy baseline profile.

system-characteristics.system-description: An enhanced-assurance institution-owned managed endpoint that meets elevated requirements for sensitive data handling, privileged access, and high-risk institutional workloads.

props.name: inherits-from-sspp
props.remarks: COBO L2 endpoints inherit all COBO L1 requirements and add enhanced assurance controls.

props.name: assurance-model
props.remarks: Provides enhanced assurance for high-risk and sensitive workflows.

props.name: eligible-data-classifications
props.remarks: Endpoint may participate in workflows involving Data Classification Levels 1, 2, and 3, subject to policy and contextual controls.

props.name: non-equivalence-statement
props.remarks: Endpoint assurance tier does not confer automatic entitlement to any data classification.

props.name: additional-identity-assurance
props.remarks: Endpoint identity must support hardware-backed attestation of boot and security state.

props.name: additional-configuration-hardening
props.remarks: COBO L2 endpoints enforce stricter configuration baselines and reduced attack surface compared to COBO L1.

props.name: enhanced-threat-protection
props.remarks: COBO L2 endpoints require advanced runtime threat detection, isolation, and response capabilities.

props.name: privileged-workload-eligibility
props.remarks: Endpoint is eligible for privileged access, administrative workflows, and regulated research use cases.

props.name: lifecycle-sensitivity
props.remarks: Trust suspension, recovery, and retirement events for COBO L2 endpoints require elevated approval and auditability.

props.name: zero-trust-alignment
props.remarks: COBO L2 posture and identity are continuously evaluated and required for high-sensitivity access decisions.

system-implementation.remarks: COBO L2 endpoints implement Secure Endpoint trust by inheriting all COBO L1 controls and layering enhanced assurance requirements.

roles.title: Endpoint Owner
roles.remarks: Accountable for appropriate use and safeguarding of COBO L2 endpoints.

roles.title: Endpoint Operations
roles.remarks: Responsible for implementing enhanced hardening, monitoring, and response on COBO L2 endpoints.

roles.title: Endpoint Governance Authority
roles.remarks: Approves COBO L2 eligibility, lifecycle transitions, and exceptions.

control-implementation.remarks: COBO L2 endpoints inherit COBO L1 trust requirements and apply additional assurance controls. OS-specific realizations (Windows, macOS, Linux) implement these requirements through separate implementation profiles.
